newsitem.title: USA: NJS to acquire stake in Kiwi Int'l Holdings.
newsitem.headline: NJS to acquire stake in Kiwi Int'l Holdings.

text.p: NJS Acquisition Corp said Monday it agreed to acquire 20 percent of Kiwi International Holdings Inc (KIH), which owns the assets of low-cost carrier Kiwi Air Lines.

KIH purchased the assets of Kiwi Air Lines for $16.5 million through an accelerated restructuring under the U.S. Bankruptcy Code. KIH was formed by Charles Edwards, who through Edwards-Wasatch Enterprises, provided debtor-in-possession financing for Kiwi.
Kiwi Air Lines had declared Chapter 11 bankruptcy in September 1996.
NJS and KIH will enter into a merger agreement within sixty days. NJS will be the surviving corporation, but the name of the company will be changed to Kiwi International Holdings Inc, NJS said.
Upon the completion of the merger, the company expects to make application for listing of its common stock on the NASDAQ Small Cap Market.
